120 .   Right to vote.—   (1) Every person whose name appears in the electoral roll 
relating to a constituency of a Zilla Panchayat shall, subject to the other provisions of this 
Act, be entitled to vote at any election which takes place in that constituency while the 
electoral roll remains in force and no person whose name does not appear in such 
electoral roll shall vote at any such election. 
(2) No person shall vote at an election under this Act in more than one constituency or 
more than once in the same constituency and if he does so all his votes shall be invalid.
